text:
katie: quick heads-up — during the payments chart canary we saw a values merge conflict when applying overlay -> the live cluster has `payments.timeout: 30s` but the new values set `payments.timeout: 60s` and there's also a `retry.max` tweak.

matt: oof. where is the diff?

katie: pasted helm diff from the canary job:

```
~ payments.timeout: 30s -> 60s
~ retry.max: 3 -> 5
+ newFeature.enabled: true
```

anika: that `timeout` change could impact long tail requests, might increase p99. any perf tests?

katie: none for this small tweak, canary only. deploy-bot shows ~1.2x p95 for payments-worker in the canary pool (small sample).

ryan: my concern is stateful workers and DB pool sizing. if timeout grows we could saturate DB. recommend pinning chart image for this release and hold the values change for a separate PR with perf validation.

matt: +1 for pin. we can still ship the binary bump but keep values identical to prod. saves rollback risk.

anika: agreed. what does deploy-bot suggest?

deploy-bot: Canary started: payments-service v1.5.0 -> v1.6.0 on eu-west-1-canary (3 pods). Observed: 22% increase in average request duration (p50 + p95 ~ +1.2x). Health checks OK.

katie: decision proposal: 1) pin chart to v1.5.1 image digest for this rollout; 2) revert values changes in the release branch (keep `newFeature.enabled` off); 3) open follow-up perf PR with a small loadtest and DB pool validation; 4) add release-notes entry describing the staged change and pin.

ryan: fine. who will update the helm values and push the pin?

matt: I can do the values revert + image pin in the release branch. will push in 10m and trigger a redeploy.

anika: also adding an item to release notes: "Staged timeout increase deferred pending perf validation; image pinned to digest to avoid drift."

katie: add runbook note: if p95 increases >1.5x after redeploy, rollback to previous image and open incident.

matt: pushed PR https://git.internal/r/infra/payments-release/pull/238 — description: revert timeout/retry changes, pin image digest `sha256:abc123...`, disable newFeature. Deploy-bot triggered redeploy.

deploy-bot: Redeploy started for payments-service on eu-west-1-canary (release branch). Post-deploy checks: pod restarts 0/3, readiness OK. Observed p95 back to baseline.

katie: thanks. can someone update the release notes draft and add one-liner for the ops digest?

anika: I'll update release-notes.md and add a short explanation + follow-up ticket.

matt: leaving a manual annotation in the release PR so release-manager sees the staged change.

ryan: long-term: we should add a preflight to catch `timeout` deltas >2x in the helm diff and auto-fail canaries or require perf signoff. marking as action item for infra backlog.

katie: agreed — filing INFRA-512. thanks all :thumbsup:
